# Pi Soroban Events Explorer — llms.txt
# A read-only, zero-dependency walker over Soroban events on Pi Network that
# reports per-window truncation and treats a truncated count as a lower bound.

> The usual story — "getEvents caps at ~10 000 ledgers and returns an empty
> array" — did not reproduce. Measured 2026-10-19 against the testnet RPC, a
> 100 000-ledger span succeeded. The real footguns are different.

## What it is
- read-only, zero-dependency, Node (ESM), Node >= 18
- events-walk.mjs: the CLI (--from --to --step --network --rpc --dry-run)
- windows.mjs: pure window/retention arithmetic (no network, importable)
- test.mjs: 34 offline checks (node --test)
- never builds, signs or submits; never writes; no API keys

## The three measured footguns
1. endLedger is EXCLUSIVE. [L, L] returns zero events; [L, L+1] returns ledger L's
   events. A single-ledger query silently finds nothing. The tool always sends
   end + 1.
2. At most 100 events per response, and limit is IGNORED. limit=1, 5, 50, 99,
   100 and 101 all returned 100.
3. The returned cursor is NOT honoured. { cursor } alone fails with
   "startLedger must be positive"; { cursor, startLedger, endLedger } ignores the
   cursor and repeats page 1. A window with 100 events therefore cannot be
   completed.

## Why it exists
An empty result is ambiguous: "no events", "wrong ledger boundary", or "page full
and no way to continue". The tool removes the ambiguity by walking explicit
windows and reporting, per window, whether it was truncated.

## The one thing to remember
When any window returns 100 events the cursor cannot continue, so events_found is
a LOWER BOUND and is printed as such. Ledger coverage can still be complete
(100%) while the event count is not a total.

## Measured constraints (2026-10-19, protocol 28)
- ledger-span cap:        none found (a 100 000-ledger span succeeded)
- events per response:    100 (limit ignored)
- cursor paging:          not honoured
- endLedger:              exclusive
- filters[].type:         "system" or "contract" only; tx-hash filtering rejected
- startLedger below retention: -32600 error (not an empty array)
- retention:              120 960 ledgers (7 days at 5 s); getHealth reports it
- getLedger / getContractData: method not found
- Mainnet Soroban RPC:    HTTP 503, certificate expired 2023-05-30

## Output shape
Per window: [from .. to] span= events= TRUNCATED (or not). Then a # Coverage
block: ledgers_requested, ledgers_covered (%), windows_walked, windows_truncated,
windows_errored, events_found (LOWER BOUND when truncated).

## Usage
- node events-walk.mjs --from 27249000 --to 27252000
- node events-walk.mjs --from 27249000 --to 27252000 --dry-run   (no network)
- node events-walk.mjs --from 1000 --to 2000 --rpc https://example.invalid
- node --test test.mjs
Exit codes: 0 ok; 1 error; 2 refused (e.g. --network mainnet without --rpc).

## Not claimed
- that "no events found" means no events exist (a window may be mis-bounded)
- that events_found is a total (it is a lower bound when truncated)
- that the 100-event cap is a protocol constant (it is an observed RPC behaviour,
  re-measured on every run)
- that event contents are interpreted correctly (this tool counts and reports)
- that Pi Network has adopted, reviewed or endorsed this
